offers.title: Staff Backend Engineer (Remote, Switzerland)
offers.description_short: Staff Backend Engineer at Nango (YC W23), the open-source platform for building product integrations supporting 700+ APIs. Write integration logic as TypeScript functions or let AI generate them, deployed to Nango's production runtime. $120–200k + equity, fully remote with a Switzerland-specific posting.
offers.match_reason: Staff-level TypeScript/Node.js infrastructure role at a YC-backed developer-tooling startup, with a Switzerland-specific remote posting — near-ideal tech, seniority, and location match.

offers.title: Staff LLM Interaction Engineer (Europe remote — TS/Vue/NodeJS)
offers.description_short: Staff-level LLM Interaction Engineer at n8n, shaping how the AI Workflow Builder works end-to-end. Owns the orchestration layer between users, workflows, and LLMs — designing context, tool interactions, and evaluation loops. TypeScript/Vue/Node.js stack, 7+ years required, remote Europe.
offers.match_reason: Staff-level AI/LLM product engineering at a fast-growing open-source automation platform — TypeScript + Node.js stack is a perfect tech fit and the AI orchestration focus aligns with Magino's AI-augmented engineering expertise.

offers.title: Founding Software Engineer — TypeScript
offers.description_short: Founding Engineer at Neuroscale AI, building Arbi — the AI recruiting operating system. Owns end-to-end feature delivery on TypeScript/Node.js backend services, AI agent orchestration, and agentic workflows integrating with ATS platforms. Early-stage, high-ownership role.
offers.match_reason: Founding engineer role with full ownership at an early-stage AI startup — TypeScript/Node.js stack and agentic workflow focus map well to Magino's profile; remote-global is a location step down but impact potential is high.

offers.title: Staff / Principal Full-Stack Engineer (B2C Anti-Cheat)
offers.description_short: Staff/Principal Full-Stack Engineer at A5 Labs, powering AI-driven online gaming experiences. Own complex systems and shape technical direction on a TypeScript/Node.js full-stack product targeting European players. Remote within EEA, 6+ years required.
offers.match_reason: Strong tech fit (TypeScript, Node.js, Staff/Principal seniority) and remote EEA location are positives; company domain (online gaming) is not impact-driven, which reduces company and impact scores.

offers.title: Head of IT (AI)
offers.description_short: Head of IT (AI) at GF-ACCORD AI, a Geneva-based stealth AI startup delivering professional, non-hallucinating AI solutions for business and financial analysis. Leadership role building the technical function, 1–4% equity, $110k–$170k. Requires deep AI/ML expertise (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
offers.match_reason: Geneva location (top priority) and leadership seniority are strong pulls; ML research stack (TensorFlow, PyTorch, PhD preferred) is a mismatch with Magino's platform/TypeScript background — worth exploring if pivoting to a fintech AI leadership track.
